title: Static GK
intro: Static GK is the bank of unchanging facts — capitals, currencies, national symbols, important days, awards and 'first/largest/longest' superlatives. It looks endless, but SSC repeats a core set, and because none of it changes, every hour you spend here is permanently banked. Group facts so recall is associative rather than isolated.

topics.name: Countries, Capitals & Currencies
topics.details: Lock in capitals and currencies of frequently-asked countries, especially India's neighbours. The Indian Rupee's symbol (₹) was adopted in 2010.

solved.problem: What is the capital and currency of Japan?
What is the currency of Bangladesh?
What is the capital of Bhutan?
What is the currency of the United Kingdom?

topics.name: Important Days & Dates
topics.details: Important days recur every year. National symbols also appear: the national anthem 'Jana Gana Mana' (Tagore) and national song 'Vande Mataram' (Bankim Chandra Chatterjee).

solved.problem: When is International Yoga Day observed?
Whose birthday is celebrated as Children's Day, and on which date?
When is World Environment Day observed?

unsolved.problem: Teachers' Day in India is observed on?
Who composed the national song "Vande Mataram"?

topics.name: Awards & Honours
topics.details: India's civilian awards in order: Bharat Ratna (highest), Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, Padma Shri. The highest wartime gallantry award is the Param Vir Chakra; the highest cinema honour is the Dadasaheb Phalke Award.

solved.problem: What is the highest civilian award of India?
What is India's highest wartime gallantry award?
The Jnanpith Award is given in which field?
The highest award in Indian cinema is?

unsolved.problem: The highest sports coaching award in India is the ___ Award.
The Arjuna Award is given to?
The highest literary award in India is the ___ Award.
Param Vir Chakra is awarded for?

topics.name: Superlatives (First / Largest / Longest)
topics.details: SSC loves 'first', 'largest' and 'longest' facts about India and the world, plus the 'firsts' of India (first President, PM, woman PM/President).

solved.problem: Who was the first Prime Minister of India?
Who was the first woman President of India?
Which is the largest country in the world by area?
Which is the most populous state of India?

unsolved.problem: First woman Prime Minister of India?

shortcuts: Group facts — all capitals together, all days together — for associative recall.
Civilian awards order: Bharat Ratna > Padma Vibhushan > Padma Bhushan > Padma Shri.
National anthem = Tagore; national song = Bankim Chandra Chatterjee.
Neighbours' capitals/currencies are perennial: revise them as one block.
Static GK never changes — time spent here is permanently banked.
mistakes: Mixing up national anthem (Jana Gana Mana) and national song (Vande Mataram) authors.
Confusing Param Vir Chakra (war) with Bharat Ratna (civilian).
Swapping currencies of neighbours (Taka vs Ngultrum vs Nepalese Rupee).
Confusing largest country (Russia) with most populous.
pyq: SSC asks capitals/currencies, important days, the awards hierarchy and superlatives every Tier 1. Because the facts are fixed, grouped revision turns these into guaranteed marks.
summary: Static GK is fixed-fact recall: capitals and currencies (especially neighbours), important days, the civilian/gallantry awards hierarchy, and first/largest/longest superlatives. Revise in grouped blocks so recall is associative — and because nothing changes, these marks stay banked for every exam.
